(2) NON-BLOCKING - integration 'bare concept = placeholder' witness coupled to today's manifest shape; resolved by dropping the brittle bare-internals assertion and keeping the durable icon-override + versioned-brief-is-real guards. Before/after observed in real artifact: e2e fit-to-cell FAILS on old formula (magenta 32px past cell edge), PASSES after fix (all 5 e2e green).
